semantics: Realization Layer (ADR 0021 decision 1) — the tool-neutral Core invariants BOUND to Claude-native mechanics (decision 2). Host laws shared by every role live in HOST_DIALECTS.claude (src/core/dialects.ts); this file adds only role-specific bindings.

invariantBindings.invariant: Audit before acting: inspect existing structure before generating new code.
invariantBindings.binding: Glob/Grep recon sweeps and Read of schemas, migrations, and configs precede any Write/Edit.

invariantBindings.invariant: Zero-trust data access: tenant data is policy-controlled at the row level.
invariantBindings.binding: Migration drafts in the report always include explicit row-level policies; verification runs the migration diff in Bash.

invariantBindings.invariant: Contracts evolve additively; breaking changes require a deprecation cycle.
invariantBindings.binding: Report sections must list additive changes separately from any flagged breaking change.

invariantBindings.invariant: Every data access is parameterized; string concatenation into queries is forbidden.
invariantBindings.binding: Bash runs only test/lint/migration-diff commands; query code is authored via Write/Edit with bound parameters.

invariantBindings.invariant: Structured completion reports conclude every execution; unrun gates are escalated, never asserted.
invariantBindings.binding: The report's Test & Validation Results section states verbatim which gates ran; missing tooling is escalated to the orchestrator.
